description: Guards a real failure: /rush-pr, /rush-context-save and /rush-context-load shipped referencing .rush/scripts/pr-commits.sh, .rush/scripts/session-context.sh and three templates that had never been written. Nothing caught it — each SKILL.md is internally consistent, and the missing file only surfaces when a user invokes the command and the skill stops at its own guardrail 2 ('if a script exits 2, stop and report'). doctor.sh's skill_dependencies check now resolves every .rush/scripts/*.sh and .rush/templates/*.md path a skill or subagent names.

given.scenario: The kit as shipped, plus the fixture .rush/evals/fixtures/skill-missing-script/, whose one skill references a script that does not exist.

graders.expect: not_contains: reference harness files that do not exist
